messages:
Noah: mid-morning check-in — gateway/routing/auth/rate limits
Noah: Yesterday: landed the prefix-routing patch for /v1/embeddings, added integration tests for jwt header passthrough.
Noah: Blockers: hitting a weird 429 pattern in staging when we run synthetic load with 10k qps; appears tied to token-bucket refactor.
Noah: Today: will triage 429, push a hotfix canary, and open a PR for ratepolicy-config docs.
Priya: Thanks — can you paste the throttling logs? could be burst window miscalc.
Priya: pinging @alex for the token-bucket changes he made last week.
Alex: looking now, I saw an off-by-one in the refill interval in my last commit. can repro locally with the same workload.
Alex: quick patch ready, will push to staging canary. @noah do you want me to include a metrics tag `rate.fix=refill-interval`?
Noah: yes please, add tag and a short note in the canary rollout. also enable `--bypass-kv-cache=false` for the test — we saw cache masking effects.
Sam: FYI I updated the jwt rotation job to skip keys older than 24h to avoid auth flaps; should reduce errors in staging.
Romain: canary plan: 10% traffic for 30m, then 50% for 15m if errors < 0.1%/min. lmk if that's too aggressive.
Noah: sounds good. will monitor latency, 429s, and auth errors. set alert on error rate > 0.2%.
Priya: I'll review the docs PR once Alex posts it. small nits likely.
Alex: pushed patch and created PR #2143. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/2143
Deploy-bot: deploy started: gw-canary-1742101111 -> 10% traffic. logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/dep/9876
Noah: thanks. I'll post quick summary in the standup thread after 30m.
Priya: :thumbsup: 
Alex: :shipit: 
Sam: ping if you need extra probes or load generators.
Noah: closing loop — will update later.
